2.88.33
Chart.Legend
Applies to RDL 2003/10 and RDL 2005/01
The Chart.Legend element specifies the legend for a Chart. This element is optional and is of type
Legend.
Following is the parent element of the Chart.Legend element.
Parent elements
Chart
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Chart.Legend element.
 <xsd:element name="Legend" type="LegendType" minOccurs="0" />
